entries.e5c90ce24d839183: CS set fees are a daily rate calculated by the number of days of hospitalization or admission rather than by what is used, so users can use the service without worrying about how often laundry and exchanges occur or how much daily necessities they use. Operations are structured so that facilities handle explanations to users, reception, lending, collection and distribution; linen supply companies, etc. handle delivery, collection and laundering; and the company group handles plan design, fee collection and inquiry response. Facilities can provide the service in a form that complies with administrative guidance on charging for services not covered by insurance, and the mechanism also reduces the workload of on-site laundry and replenishment of daily necessities.
